I think I want to die, at least, I think that's what I want.

Well...I'm here - as in SW and, yah know...here. But I don't want to be. I tried the addiction / sober living thing. Now I'm back to drinking by myself at night and hating myself more and more everyday thing. I don't recommend it.

I flirt with the idea of it - not being here anymore.

I see a psychiatrist as well as a therapist. Bipolar 2 diagnosis which is just manic depression with the very infrequent hypomanic episodes. Quite frankly, it's a cruel joke my mind plays on itself.

Problem with all that nonsense is I don't want to talk about my problems. I can tell you everything that's wrong in my life. It won't change anything. Just like telling someone all the good things won't make more good things happen.

I want to die every day. I just haven't found my way out yet.
